No. With the Moon at **−31.3° altitude**, it is about **31° below your horizon**, so Earth itself blocks it from view. Clear skies, darkness, and knowing where to look cannot overcome that.

The **11% illumination** would make it a plausible thin crescent if it were above the horizon, but at **02:39 GMT in Reykjavík it is definitely not visible**. You would need to wait until it rises.
